name: resolve accelerator dependency conflicts between frameworks
definition: Make two deep-learning frameworks coexist by choosing compatible accelerator/numeric bindings, one CPU-only set, or a set of versions that do not clash on the same toolkit version.
failure_mode: Two different pinned accelerator versions in one env break solve/tests the solver stage.

name: resolve npm conflicts and install a complete node_modules tree
definition: Diagnose declared/transitive dependency conflicts, edit the manifest, install, and verify everything resolves.
failure_mode: an irresolvable pin left one required package uninstalled, failing the installed-set check

name: run a focused test subset of a scientific package and iterate on the failing assertions
definition: Execute the relevant test file, interpret the failure, and adjust the source fix until targeted tests pass without disturbing other tests.
failure_mode: Fix breaks unrelated model compositions or fails the added cases

name: run a provided example script to confirm a successful install
definition: execute the given reference example under the venv and confirm it neither crashes nor throws and prints a success marker.
failure_mode: build/import errors in the example fail the run assertion
